## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes (tests added or updated if behaviour changed)
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] One change per PR, with clear commit messages
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, keystores, databases or personal data in the diff
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed
